items.t: Is Verizon Stock Worth Buying as Cash Flow Improves but Risks Persist?
items.sum: VZ's rising free cash flow, improving subscriber trends and modest valuation bolster its appeal, but high debt and pricing pressure keep risks in focus.

items.t: Can Verizon's $4 Billion AI Contracts Add Meaningful Growth in 2027?
items.sum: VZ's $4 billion AI infrastructure contracts promise a new revenue stream in 2027, but modest sales growth and core business pressures temper the upside.

items.t: LALIGA, Verizon Extend Long-Term Partnership in U.S. and Canada on Heels of Historic FIFA World Cup 2026™
items.sum: The FIFA World Cup 2026™ not only reinforced the existing interest in soccer throughout North America, it also highlighted that the game is still growing. Driven by young, diverse and multicultural audiences, this summer's FIFA World Cup 2026™ was a historic event in terms of attendance, viewership and engagement.
